use_case_name: Monitor Current and Past Auction Status

claims.content: The Auctioneer or Customer Service Representative wants to monitor the current and past statuses of auctions, including live/current and closed/past states, to aid in troubleshooting or administration.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Auctioneer or Customer Service Representative wants to monitor the current and past statuses of auctions, including live/current and closed/past states, to aid in troubleshooting or administration.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: Customer opens a customer-facing auction-status view and sees a list/table of relevant auctions with statuses such as current/live, scheduled, and closed, along with details like start/end dates, bids, and winners.
scope_contract.start_boundary: Customer is on a customer-facing auction-status view and requests auction status information.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The customer-facing view displays current and past auction statuses with enough detail to see where each auction stands.
in_scope_actions: View past/closed and scheduled auction status
View auction details such as start/end dates, bids, and winners
excluded_adjacent_actions: Post-auction checkout, payment, or order fulfillment
variant_dimensions: Entry point: My Account current bids/bid history/recently ended auctions vs SKU history page
Auction status categories: Unscheduled, Scheduled, Current (Live), Closed
